keys.responses: rows of response_leaf for the yield (variable ly, one per index), in column order, unrounded; a row noted no_own_slope has slope_eb, se_eb, pct_eb, lo_eb and hi_eb withheld
keys.predictions: rows of prediction_series for this series (one per method and scenario), in column order
keys.calendar: rows of calendar_status for this series (one per harvest year), in column order; cycle_unresolved is cycle == 'both' or confidence == 'missing'
keys.weight: the weights row of this series for the target year, in column order
keys.crop_area: per unit, per crop family: [hectares harvested in 2020, share of the unit's land] from CROPGRIDS v1.08 through the crosswalk; null where no figure
keys.clusters: per unit, per crop family: [cluster_key, cluster_name] of the unit's weather-coherent growing region (unit_clusters, lib/clusters.py); null where the release carries no cluster table; the key equals the country code where the family has fewer than ten units
keys.records: records/POL/<unit file>.json per unit, listed in records/POL/index.json: observations, trend, anomalies, exposures, QC, the weather-variable responses and the season-to-date weather; records/{iso}/cluster_<key>.json per growing region, listed under clusters
